QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` has `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`, so the threading layer is off. ... `mbedtls_config.h:2185` (`MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT`) and `:2196` (`MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD`) are also commented out.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the shipped config header has THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD (and ALT) commented out, so a default build defines none of the threading macros.
